text:
noah: Originate RC build: rc-2026-03-21b (artifact tag rc-b21). Built with model v2.4.3-rc2, quant=q4f16-2026-03. Requesting ops pin + KV warm. Proposed quiet window 22:30-23:30 UTC. Need explicit rollback plan and post-promote smoke.

deploy-bot: [CI] RC created: rc-2026-03-21b (build 810). Artifacts pushed to registry and s3://ci/rc-810/. Started kv-warm job id=kv-810.

sana: Quick smoke in staging looks fine. Noted a minor tokenization diff in the embedding pipeline but within tolerance. Added a regression test to catch it.

kevin: From infra: please ensure node selectors prefer low-latency racks for this RC. Also recommend setting circuit-breaker thresholds at 2x baseline to avoid cascading rollouts. Sample rollback snippet below:

```
# rollback to last stable tag
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03.12 -n prod
# revert traffic policy
curl -X POST "${DEPLOY_API}/v1/traffic" -d '{"from":"candidate","to":"stable","percent":100}'
# trigger deploy-bot rollback
deploy-bot rollback --id rc-2026-03-21b --reason "telemetry-anomaly"
```

release-coordinator: Added RC to release calendar and set the canary ramp timeline: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100. Quiet window OK. Noted that marketing wants a short blurb for the blog if full promote completes.

deploy-bot: KV warming progress: 35% complete, estimated 3m to finish. Logs: warming using prefixes list, approx 900k keys.

noah: Canary plan: start at 0.5% for 10m; if p95 < 180ms and errors < 0.7% then step to 5% for 20m; then 25% for 20m. If all green, final promote at ~23:15 UTC. Telemetry dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/rc-21b. Please monitor token-cost and model memory.

kevin: LGTM. I'll watch autoscaler and infra metrics. I've prepared a hotfix branch if we need emergency revert with a prebaked image.

sheriff-oncall: I'm on-call for the window and will be at console at 22:15 UTC. Setting myself as primary. If we see GPU OOMs or errors spike >1% I'll cut traffic back.

sana: Release notes draft ready at https://docs.redwood/release-notes/rc-2026-03-21b.md. Added notes about embedding tokenization and model pin.

release-coordinator: We need a short runbook entry for customers on how to handle the embedding diffs — added a short FAQ in the doc.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: 0.5% traffic to rc-2026-03-21b at 2026-03-21T22:30:30Z. Initial metrics: p95=145ms, errors=0.09%, cpu=52%, gpu=40%.

noah: Holding 10m. If green, step to 5%.

kevin: No anomalies. Proceed to 5% now.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% complete at 2026-03-21T22:41:00Z. Monitoring continues.

noah: Observed slight uplift in token-cost at 5% (~4%). That's expected due to longer generated outputs in a subset of requests. Will watch impact on cost dashboards.

sana: Reg-test for tokenization diff passed in CI — good to go to 25% after 20m.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% started at 2026-03-21T23:05:12Z.

release-coordinator: Marketing note: prepping a small blurb if final promote proceeds. Also pinging enterprise customers about the quiet window.

kevin: At 25% now. Keeping an eye on tail latency. No GPU memory pressure.

sheriff-oncall: All clear in my watch. Approving final promote after the 25% hold if metrics remain stable.

noah: Promoting to 100% now. Final artifact pin: registry:redwood/inference:rc-b21 and model:v2.4.3-rc2.

deploy-bot: [deploy] promote to prod started at 2026-03-21T23:28:40Z -> 100% traffic.
[deploy] final metrics after promo: p95=152ms, errors=0.11%, token-cost uplift=3.8%, cpu=60%, gpu=46%.

release-coordinator: Promotion complete. Sending release email and updating release notes. Will open a postmortem if any regressions are reported by customers.

noah: Thanks team. Locking RC-2026-03-21b as promoted and closing the thread. :tada:
